senses.gloss: (b. h.) to handle; ש׳ ב־ (cmp. מָשַׁל) to rule, have power over.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Terumot 8:3:18">Y. Ter. VIII, 45ᵈ</cite> top <he>כאן האור שׁוֹלֵט וכ׳</he> here (in the case of bread) the fire comes in direct contact with it (and kills the poison of the serpent), there (in the case of water that has been warmed) the fire does not &c.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Maasrot 1:4:10">Y. Maasr. I, 49ᵇ</cite> top <he>כאן היד שׁוֹלֶטֶת וכ׳</he> here (in the case of a vessel into which a boiling dish has been put) the hand can handle it; there (in the case of a vessel taken directly from the fire) the hand cannot handle it; <he>כאן וכאן אין היד שולטת בו</he> in both cases the dish may be too hot for the hand to handle it; Y. Sabb. III, 6ᵇ top.

<cite ref="Yoma 2a">Ib.</cite> <he>במקום שהיד שולטת</he> in a place (in the stove) which the hand can get at (to handle the dish placed there); ib. 5ᶜ <he>מפני שהוא שַׁלִּיט במקום שהיד שולטת</he> because he keeps control (to regulate the temperature of the dish) there where the handling is possible.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bava Metzia 10:1:3">Y. B. Mets. X, beg. 12ᶜ</cite> <he>ששולטת היד מצר אחד</he> that the hand can reach it from one side.
<cite ref="Chullin 16b">Ḥull. 16ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Shabbat 82a:4">Sabb. 82ᵃ</cite> <he>דבר שהאור שולטת בו</he> a thing over which fire has power (which is combustible).
Ib. רוח רעה שולטת בו an evil spirit (smell of the mouth) will seize him; רוח זוהמא ש׳ בו (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 30) the spirit of zohăma (internal decay) will seize him.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 45:4">Gen. R. s. 45</cite>) <he>שָׁלְטוּ בעצמן</he> they controlled themselves (interrupted their gratification).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 9:1:22">Y. Ber. IX, 13ᵇ</cite> top <he>שולט באיפרכיא וכ׳</he> if he rules over one province, he does not rule over another province.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 3:6">Gen. R. s. 3</cite> <he>ביום אני שולט</he> I want to rule (have the guard) in day time; (<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 8:6:9">Y. Ber. VIII, 12ᶜ</cite> top <he>משמש</he>).
<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 31:1">Pesik. R. s. 31</cite> <he>אתם שְׁלַטְתֶּם בעצמיכם וכ׳</he> (not <he>באצבעותיכם</he>) you had power over yourselves and cut your fingers off; a. v. fr.

senses.gloss: <cite ref="U01280">same</cite>. Y. Naz. IV, 53ᵇ <he>במְשַׁלֶּטֶת על נכסיו</he> when she manages her husband’s property (has power of attorney).
to give power to, make a ruler.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 59:7">Gen. R. s. 59</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Genesis 24:1">Gen. XXIV, 1</cite>) <he>שהִשְׁלִיטוֹ ביצרו</he> God made him master over his inclinations; Yalk. ib. 103.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 14:7">Num. R. s. 14<sup>6</sup></cite> <he>השליטו על ארץ וכ׳</he> the Lord made him governor of the land of Egypt; a. e.

senses.gloss: to be given power; to be empowered to manage. Y. Keth. IX, 33ᵃ bot. נכסים שׁנִשְׁתַּלְּטָה בהן בחיי וכ׳ property which she had been authorized to manage during her husband’s lifetime; ib. 33ᵇ top.
